div.head: Northu 10.1
div.ab: ⁊ gif hæþen cild binnon IX nihton þurh gimeliste forfaren sy, betan for Gode buton worldwite; ⁊ gif hit ofer nigan niht gewurðe, betan for Gode, ⁊ gilde XII ór for ðare heorde, þe he wæs hæþen swa lange.

And if a child dies heathen within nine days, through carelessness, amends are to be made to God, without a secular fine; and if it occur after nine days, amends are to be made to God, and 12 ores to be paid for the [lack of] care, that it remained heathen so long.
And if a child dies a heathen within nine nights out of neglect, penance is to be done before God and twelves ores are to be paid for that neglect, because he remained a heathen for so long.

Und wenn ein durch Nachlässigkeit ungetauftes Kind innerhalb 9 Tagen gestorben ist, so mögen sie [die Eltern nur] geistlich büssen, ohne materielles Strafgeld; wenn das [Sterben] jedoch nach 9 Tagen geschieht, sollen sie geistlich büssen, und er [der Vormund] zahle 12 Ör für die Obhut[sverletzung], dass es so lange ungetauft gewesen ist.

And if a child unbaptised through negligence has died within 9 days, let them [the parents] atone [only] spiritually, without a secular fine; but if [the death] happens after 9 days, let them atone spiritually, and let him [the guardian] pay 12 ores for the [breach of] care, that it was unbaptised so long.
div.note: U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If if a child dies a heathen within nine days, through carelessness, amends are to be made to God, without a secular fine; and if it occur after nine days, amends are to be made to God, and 12 ores to be paid for the [lack of] care, that it remained heathen so long.’).
